jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Test Automation Engineer Company: Nxtjob.ai Location: Bangalore Hybrid Employment Type: Full-time Experience: 2+ years Compensation: 913 LPA CTC, based on experience Reports To: Engineering Lead About the Role Nxtjob.ai currently ships to production with zero automated test coverage. As our first Test Automation Engineer, you will build the quality and automation foundation for our AI-native stack across the frontend, backend, and model outputs. This is a from-zero opportunity where you will own what gets automated, how it integrates with CI, and how we ensure both application logic and AI behaviour remain reliable. What You'll Own Build the Safety Net from Zero Build automated unit, integration, smoke, and regression test suites across the Next.js frontend and Node.js backend. Establish test automation from scratch. Integrate automated testing into CI/CD so broken builds are identified before production. Prioritize and automate the core user and business flows that matter most. Test the Model, Not Just the Code Build automated test cases for LLM agent outputs. Use Langfuse traces and evaluation frameworks to identify regressions in prompt and model behaviour. Define clear pass/fail criteria for AI output quality. Convert recurring production failures into permanent regression tests in collaboration with support and QA. Make Quality Everyone's Responsibility Document test coverage, gaps, and quality risks clearly for the engineering team. Embed automated testing into the team's daily development workflow rather than treating QA as a separate final phase. What You Bring 2+ years of hands-on experience building test automation for frontend and backend applications. Strong experience with automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium. Experience with API testing. Working knowledge of CI/CD and integrating automated tests into development pipelines. Comfortable with, or eager to quickly learn, testing LLM-based systems, including prompt evaluation and output consistency. Exposure to tools such as Langfuse is a plus. Strong ability to prioritize high-impact automation in a from-zero environment. Experience building test suites rather than primarily executing manual test cases. Why This Role? This is the opportunity to build the test automation and quality foundation Nxtjob.ai has never had — for both application code and AI model behaviour. 2-5 Yrs Test Automation Framework, Playwright Automation, JavaScript / Node.js, Langfuse, Ci/Cd, LLM Testing / AI Testing, QA Testing, Cypress

jobs.title: Sr./Lead QA Automation Engineer - AI Agent
jobs.description: Job Summary Sr./Lead QA Automation Engineer - AI Agent Are you a quality engineer who wants to build confidence in a fast-evolving AI agent - not just execute manual test cases. At SimCorp, we are developing an internal AI agent that supports the software development lifecycle (SDLC): a production-grade, distributed agent hosted in Azure - running 24/7, accessible to everyone in the company, and spanning deep integrations with our engineering systems, secure code execution, and remote development capabilities on user machines. We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer to own and evolve the quality strategy for this product. The product's risk sits in cross-service behavior - where agent runs, tool calls, external integrations, and cloud infrastructure meet. The role blends hands-on manual and exploratory testing of new features and AI behavior with designing and building the automated test system - acceptance, integration, contract, and post-deployment validation - that lets the team ship quickly without breaking critical engineering workflows. Responsibilities Test strategy and hands-on testing Define and own the products test strategy across unit, functional, integration, acceptance, post-deployment, and exploratory testing. Perform hands-on manual and exploratory testing of new features, AI-agent behavior, and edge cases before and alongside automation. Design approaches for testing non-deterministic AI/LLM behavior, tool-use correctness, and prompt regressions. Automated coverage Build browser-level acceptance tests that cover key user journeys end to end, from the UI down to persistence and background processing. Create validation for MCP endpoints, including authentication flows, client compatibility, and tool schemas. Design contract and replay-based tests for critical external integrations where live systems are slow, expensive, or unstable. Strengthen test coverage for the highest-risk execution surfaces: sandboxed code execution and the agents remote sessions on user machines. Release confidence and test infrastructure Add post-deployment smoke tests that catch environment, configuration, and identity failures, giving rollback confidence. Introduce failure-injection scenarios - service restarts, network loss, expired tokens, rate limits - to prove the product degrades gracefully. Improve test data, fixtures, fake connectors, and CI test categorization; manage flaky tests and keep pipelines fast and trustworthy. Collaboration and quality leadership Partner with engineers to make features testable and define acceptance criteria before implementation; mentor the team in testing practices. Monitor quality signals from CI, static analysis, telemetry, production incidents, and user feedback, and build release-readiness reporting. What we value Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. We expect you to be strong in several of the following and interested in learning the rest: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. 6+ years of experience in quality engineering / test automation for complex web and API platforms. Strong C#/.NET test development skills: xUnit/NUnit-style frameworks, mocks and fakes, test fixtures, and CI integration. Solid experience with API and integration testing, including authentication and distributed-system failure modes. Experience with browser automation such as Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent. Strong manual and exploratory testing skills, and the ability to design test strategies rather than only execute predefined cases. Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, test categorization, flaky-test management, and post-deployment smoke testing. Ability to investigate failures using logs, traces, telemetry, screenshots, and reproducible minimal scenarios. Experience testing AI/LLM products, agentic workflows, streaming responses, or other non-deterministic behavior is a strong advantage. At least 1 year of hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex in your daily work. Familiarity with open-source agents (e.g., OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, or similar) and how they behave in practice. Passion for the AI space and the flexibility to try new technologies: you stay on top of market trends and bring the ecosystems best practices - better memory, context management, and agent autonomy - into how we build and test the product. Working knowledge of Linux and containerized environments (Docker), enough to test and investigate sandboxed code execution, is a strong advantage. Experience with Test containers, contract testing, Azure identity, or Windows automation is a plus. Proven ability to lead quality direction, influence engineers, and raise the testing bar across a team. Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken. Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change.
